style_line: Premium 3D animated feature film style, warm Uzbek family courtyard, golden late-afternoon light through grape leaves, soft rounded characters with expressive faces, rich warm colours, gentle magical glow. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark.

refs.prompt: Vertical 9:16 wide shot of a cosy Uzbek family courtyard in late afternoon: a wooden raised platform (sori) with red patterned cushions and a low table with a teapot and bowls, a grapevine trellis overhead, a small square patch of dark soft garden soil in the middle of the brick yard, blue painted wooden gate, a low mud-brick wall. No people.

Vertical 9:16 full-body character of a kind Uzbek grandfather of about 70, round friendly face, short white beard, black-and-white embroidered square skullcap (doppi), round wire glasses on the tip of his nose (his continuity mark), green striped chapan robe with a cloth belt, soft leather boots, a twinkle in his eye.

Vertical 9:16 full-body character of a lively Uzbek boy of about 10, messy black curly hair, big curious brown eyes, a gap from one missing front tooth (his continuity mark), bright orange T-shirt, blue shorts, red sneakers, counting on his fingers with a confident grin.

Combine the attached images into one vertical 9:16 shot: the grandfather and the boy sit cross-legged on the courtyard platform under the grapevine; between them on the low table lies a small cloth bundle tied with string, and the grandfather rests his hand on it. Same faces and clothes, golden light.

Change the scene: the grandfather now kneels at the patch of garden soil in the middle of the courtyard, where a small glowing golden sapling has grown with exactly ten small round shining golden fruits; the boy crouches beside him, eyes wide. Same faces and clothes, same courtyard, 9:16.

Change the scene: the golden sapling has become a huge glowing golden tree whose crown fills the whole courtyard above the grapevine, heavy with hundreds of shining golden fruits; the boy stands under it with his jaw dropped, the grandfather beside him smiling and adjusting his glasses. Same faces and clothes, 9:16.

Change the scene: over the low mud-brick wall behind the golden tree creeps a dark grey thorny vine with dull grey fruits, growing in the same branching shape as the golden tree, casting a long shadow into the yard; the boy and the grandfather turn to look at it, the boy gulping. lines.text: Bir million soʻm. Bankka qoʻysang, yiliga oʻn foiz beradi. Uch yilda qancha boʻladi?

scenes.prompt: The grandfather drops the cloth bundle on the low table with a satisfying thump and pushes his glasses up, looking at the boy over them like a quiz master. Audio: thump, tea pouring, sparrows in the vine. He speaks in Uzbek with a warm, slow, slightly raspy Uzbek grandfather voice of about 70, amused: "Bir million so'm. Bankka qo'ysang, yiliga o'n foiz beradi. Uch yilda qancha bo'ladi?" Lip-sync: only the grandfather speaks, the boy's mouth stays closed. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Oson! Har yili yuz ming. Uch yilda — bir million uch yuz ming!
